location.label: Location
location.description: Location for the display of the weather.

showthreeday.label: Show Three Day Forecast
showthreeday.description: Toggle between three day and single day display.

extended_forecast.label: Extended Forecast
extended_forecast.description: In the three day display, slide over to the following three days.

current_conditions.label: Current Conditions Icon
current_conditions.description: Show today's current conditions instead of the daily forecast icon. Uses one extra One Call API 4.0 call per refresh.

current_temp.label: Current Temperature
current_temp.description: Show the current temperature in place of today's day name. Requires a One Call key; uses one extra One Call API 4.0 call per refresh.

force_1x_images.label: Force 1x Images
force_1x_images.description: The two-day forecast images have been upscaled to 2x. Enable this if you prefer the crispier look of the 1x images.
